research: The catalogue does not date this individual item. The date range is inherited from the collection record and does not establish the date of this passage. The brief catalogue entry names Johann Georg Rosenberg with widow Krögers and later Hermann Jürgen Stricker. 1568-1773_2.json repeats Stricker and Hans Jörgen Rosenberg in the same volume, suggesting a possible shared context but not proving identity or kinship. The Brakel Rosenbergs include similarly named men (ai_2026.json), yet the excerpt supplies no place, date, or connection to Brakel; neither Brakel nor another permitted family was established from that excerpt alone. Further comparison supports a tentative Brakel attribution: the Brakel citizenship register records Urbanus Jordan with wife Elisabeth Gogreben in 1670, matching the unusual Jordan/Gogreffen association in 1568-1773_2.json, and records Strickers and a Johan Jürgen Rosenberg family in Brakel. The two Rosenberg/Stricker references in volume 2 reinforce a shared local context, although the precise relationships and individual identities remain unproven. The neighboring inventory item 1727.json explicitly concerns Brakel but its shared B 605 collection alone cannot locate this specific volume.
